subject: SOC 2 Type II — Shotlist & what to share (templates and bridge letter ask)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — Shotlist & what to share (templates and bridge letter ask)

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re kicking off the intake for Acme’s SOC 2 Type II materials so your security and procurement teams can get the artifacts they need. To keep this tight for your engineers, I put together a short "shotlist" (what we typically need first) plus two one-line reply templates you can forward internally.

High-level asks (ideal first delivery):
- Final SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + auditor attestation (if separate)
- Bridge letter if the report period doesn’t cover our requested window (short signed PDF)
- Audit period covered (start/end dates) — we need this to confirm overlap with our requested window
- Evidence samples (small set): policy snapshots (access control, incident response), SSO/SAML config screenshot, encryption at rest config, sample retention policy, and a representative logs extract (redacted ok)
- List of third-party subservice organizations referenced in the report (name + short role)

Secure transfer options we accept: Google Drive folder (preferable), pre-signed S3 links, SFTP, or an enterprise transfer link. If you prefer, we can share a short SFTP presigned recipe or a Drive folder and add a retention policy for 30 days.

Attached: short shotlist template, bridge letter sample, and a simple evidence manifest CSV to populate. Below are two one-line internal replies your team can forward to the app/security owners to reduce back-and-forth. Feel free to edit.

One-line reply (fast):
"We need the SOC 2 Type II report + a bridge letter if the audit period doesn't align. Please upload the report and these sample artifacts to the shared Drive folder here: <drive link>. Contact Marissa if anything needs redaction."

One-line reply (engineering friendly):
"Can you export a 2–7 day sample of the auth/log stream (redacted) + SAML metadata screenshot + encryption-at-rest config? Upload to the Acme->Redwood Drive folder and mark files with the evidence_manifest.csv ID."

Timeline: can you confirm by EOD today whether you can provide the full report and a bridge letter within 3 business days? If not, what’s realistic?

Thanks — copying Karthik and Naomi for intake coordination.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_shotlist_template.docx (docx), bridge_letter_sample.docx (docx), evidence_manifest.csv (csv)

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Mar 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — Shotlist & what to share (templates and bridge letter ask)

Hi Marissa — thanks, this is great and much clearer than my original ask.

Quick Qs:
1) Audit period: our Type II covers 2024-10-01 through 2025-03-31. Does that window work for you or do you need different overlap?
2) Logs: we can produce a redacted auth log sample. Would a 7-day slice in NDJSON be fine?
3) Bridge letter: our legal prefers to draft the initial bridge — would your sample bridge letter help us to mirror language?

Happy to upload to Drive. I’ll confirm internal owners and share an initial package (report PDF + auditor attestation + NDA redaction request form) by EOD tomorrow at the latest.

— Alex
Alex Jenkins
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics
attachments: nda_acme_signed.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Mar 2025 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — Shotlist & what to share (templates and bridge letter ask)

Thanks Alex — that period (2024-10-01 -> 2025-03-31) is perfect and covers what our auditors expect. A 7-day NDJSON auth log sample is fine; redaction for PII is expected.

Bridge letter: yes, our sample will help and we’re happy to iterate — see attached bridge_letter_sample.docx. Suggested small edits for legal teams (you can paste into your counsel):
- One paragraph stating the report period and confirming there were no control changes that reduce coverage since the period end
- Statement about intended timeframe for any follow-up or supplementary evidence (30 days typical)

Recommended delivery checklist (for your internal owners):
- SOC2_TypeII_<period>.pdf (final report)
- Auditor_Attestation_<period>.pdf (if separate)
- Bridge_Letter_Draft.docx (editable)
- evidence_manifest.csv (map file names to control IDs)
- 7-day_auth_sample.ndjson (redacted)
- screenshots: SAML metadata, KMS/config, retention policy excerpt

Transfer options (copying plan for intake):
- Drive: create folder Acme -> Redwood -> SOC2_2025_03 and grant marissa.cole@redwood.com access
- S3 presigned URLs: if you prefer, upload to a temporary bucket and we’ll pull it down (we have an intake script)
- If you’d like an SFTP endpoint (temporary), Karthik can stand that up — @Karthik, can you share the one-line SFTP instructions?

One-line reply templates (shorter set you can forward):
1) For legal: "Please upload SOC 2 Type II report PDF and auditor attestation to the shared Drive folder and attach a draft bridge letter if the audit period ends before 2025-03-31."
2) For engineering: "Please provide a redacted 7-day NDJSON auth log sample, SAML metadata screenshot, and KMS config screenshot; drop in the shared Drive folder and add entries to evidence_manifest.csv."

If you confirm Drive, we’ll send the folder link and a 30-day retention tag. Aiming to have the intake ticket closed once we have the PDF + bridge draft + one redacted log sample.

Best,
Marissa
